answer_1.quote: grammatical error correction (GEC) is the task of also correcting these errors... GEC is often considered a sequence-to-sequence translation task, where systems learn to "translate" an ungrammatical input sentence to a grammatical output sentence
datasets: National University of Singapore Corpus of Learner English (NUCLE)
answer_1.outputs: grammatical output sentences from ungrammatical input sentences

answer_2.quote: we report token-level precision, recall and F 0.5 for detecting incorrect labels... we report 1) binarised F 0.5 which is the score for detecting any non-C labels regardless of class, and 2) macro-averaged F 0.5 which is the average F 0.5 across all classes
